camera.note: S01->S02 pull-back at f91, 5.0 px/mm, easing out toward F0 (3.3) at f114.  Zoom about the FRAME CENTRE (the docstring/JSON mismatch of v1 is fixed: the code and the docstring both say frame centre).  View top-left = sheet (168, 5) mm = local (40, 5).  RATE 0.012/frame (180-deg shutter -> ~8 px at the extreme corners, ~6 px at the thread tie-down).  The storyboard's S01 smoothstep gives d(ln s)/df = -0.036 at f91 (46 px/frame at the edge): the orchestrator must ease S01 out harder or cut the shutter around f85-100.  Because a pure centre zoom cannot bring a tie-down that S01's macro frames at the frame centre to the upper left, the S01->S02 path needs a pan as well: required end state at f91: top-left (168, 5) mm at 5.0 px/mm; at f114 (F0 hold): view x 12-788, y 2-438 mm (3.3 px/mm).
